frames.stage: 坐稳取竿，衔接准备握竿

method: 51 baked records across twelve states. Every pose uses authored jaw/wrist contours and source-color paw components with exclusive original-pixel ownership. Head, body and both paws are exported separately. Gripped rods sit between the paws and use the actual head alpha for occlusion. Held fish render below both paws. The sit handoff reuses the ready pose. Five palette skins use the same contour model; decorations are not included.

characterMaskModel.method: Pose-specific jaw/wrist contours, source-color connected paw regions and disjoint original-alpha ownership. No proportional head crop or circular hand masks.

underwaterFishOrientation: head-right, dorsal-up: clockwise rotation followed by vertical reflection
